title: What it actually compares
intro: Not instruments in the abstract. Four different ways to take exposure to the same market — each with a radically different cost structure.
etf_desc: Linear exposure, simple structure. Low costs over the long run. Suited for systematic exposure.
cfd_desc: Flexible access with leverage. Spread and overnight costs can compound significantly on multi-day holds.
futures_desc: Efficient structure for larger exposures. Periodic rollover and margin requirements to account for.
options_desc: Non-linear exposure. Theta decay erodes value over time. Useful structure with relevant implicit costs.
